title: Completed retrofit permits appear on 52 parcels listed as noncompliant

beats.text: This is a lead about how San Francisco tracks seismic retrofits.

visual.sub: The program requires a final certificate and applies different deadlines

beats.text: The code requires a final certificate for each covered building.

visual.kicker: The program requires a final certificate and applies different deadlines

beats.text: One deadline was extended to September 15, 2021.

visual.kicker: The program requires a final certificate and applies different deadlines

beats.text: The City reported 95% compliance. Its program entries support that rounded figure.

visual.label: The 95% citywide statement reproduces from the dated register

beats.text: But parcels and buildings are different units.
On 225 parcels, every program entry said noncompliant.

visual.label: Completed permits appear on 52 parcels listed only as noncompliant

beats.text: On 52 of them, related building permits had already been completed.

visual.label: Completed permits appear on 52 parcels listed only as noncompliant

beats.text: Some permits covered separate commercial and residential work.

visual.kicker: Completed permits appear on 52 parcels listed only as noncompliant

beats.text: A completed permit may cover only part of a building.
Enforcement records showed hearings on 130 parcels.

visual.label: Enforcement records explain part of the history

beats.text: Five had both a closed complaint and a completed permit.

visual.kicker: Enforcement records explain part of the history

beats.text: Which permits received a building-wide certificate? The records leave that question open.
A lead is a question, not an accusation.
